referrals.name: Police emergency
referrals.note: If anyone is in immediate danger.

referrals.name: Punjab Women's Toll-Free Helpline
referrals.note: 24/7. Discrimination, harassment, violence and denied legal rights. Punjab residents.

referrals.name: Ministry of Human Rights helpline
referrals.note: Toll-free national helpline of the Ministry of Human Rights: free legal advice and referrals. Number confirmed on mohr.gov.pk.

referrals.name: Umang Pakistan mental health helpline
referrals.note: Mental health and suicide-prevention support. Reported as 24/7; hours not yet confirmed.
referrals.verification_note: NOT VERIFIED (2026-11-11). Dawn (3 Jun 2022) confirms Google launched a suicide hotline with Umang Pakistan but prints no number. 0311-7786264 appears in several press and helpline-directory pages; one page lists a different number. umang.com.pk served only a directory listing when fetched. A person must call and confirm the number and hours (or read them on Umang's own site), then set verified=true and update source_url.

referrals.name: Ombudsperson Punjab (workplace harassment and women's property rights)
referrals.note: Complaints under the harassment Act and the Punjab women's property Act.

referrals.name: Federal Ombudsperson (FOSPAH), Islamabad
referrals.note: Workplace harassment complaints and Islamabad women's property complaints. Phone number not collected: check the website.

referrals.name: Provincial Labour Department
referrals.note: File a minimum wage or unpaid wage complaint with the labour office of your province or district.
